recommendation:
Split maintenance into two computed loops. Do not grow index.md, do not move synthesis onto the task agent, and do not treat nightly no-ops as a cadence bug.

1) TRIGGER. Keep promotion nightly and computed from Git/fs (CONCEPT.md:16–19). Today's no-ops are correct on CV/image-maze/Homeflix (`PROMOTION_RANGE=none`). Backlogs sit on vaults with no promotion timer (Music 37, codebase-design 18, Scripts 12) or `PROMOTION_RANGE=invalid` (sql, Scripts). Install the existing oneshot template on every qualifying vault. Do not promote at end-of-session — that reopens separate-capture (CONCEPT.md:13–15). Split operations: Loop A deterministic catalog compile on the existing lint timer (8 vaults, no Pi); Loop B agent promotion only when `PROMOTION_REQUIRED=1` and the range is valid. Unblock sql/Scripts by widening `LOG_DATED_HEADING_RE` (wiki_lint.py:19) to accept bare `## YYYY-MM-DD`. Do not edit append-only logs. That argues against CONCEPT.md:96–97 (human must normalise headings) without reopening evidence-trail rewrite: parser change, not mutation.

2) READ PATH. All nine vaults already have hand `map.md` (scaffold.py:262–292); Homeflix's is the working compact index. The failure is the prescribed first move: scaffold.py:163 reads `index.md` first; run-promotion.sh:122 tells the writer to read `AGENTS.md`, `index.md`, and `log.md` (image-maze log = 49,767 tokens). Add generated, gitignored `_meta/dirs.md` (≤600 tokens: one line per directory, page count, newest `git log -1 --format=%cs`, 6-word gist) and `_meta/catalog.jsonl` (path, kind=parent dir, title=H1, summary=first prose sentence ≤160 chars, bytes, git date, inbound). `wiki_lint.py --write-catalog` regenerates when missing or when a header `page_set_hash` (eligible paths+bytes+git dates, same skip rules as lint: scratch/temp/templates/log) mismatches. Agent first move: (a) read `_meta/dirs.md` only; (b) `rg -i '<terms>' _meta/catalog.jsonl` (or cat if <2KB); (c) open ≤3 pages; (d) on zero hits, `qmd search` (skill-stated ~0.5s), never `qmd query` (measured 67.1s). Keep curated `index.md` and curated `map.md` (CONCEPT.md:33–37). Detector flags `map_is_scaffold_stub` when `map.md` still matches the scaffold template.

3) LINKING. Orphan-ness is the wrong success metric. Reachability := listed in catalog.jsonl. That makes “everything linked” true without prose spam. Do not auto-insert links into existing pages (Gate 1). New pages only: ≤3 see-also links to pages actually read. Keep index backfill findings/decisions-only. Link syntax: majority already in the vault (Music = wikilink; else Markdown). Never convert. Defer Brain `[[wikilink]]`+`[cite:N]` and notes/ vs knowledge/.

4) PAGE CONTRACT. No required frontmatter, no `Updated:` field (CONCEPT.md:38–39). The contract lives in the catalog line (computed). New pages/sections only: H1 + first paragraph ≤160 chars. Lint warns >12KB; a promote that would grow a >12KB page creates a sibling instead of appending. Do not split existing 70KB pages in this pass.

5) SAFETY. No gate relaxed. Catalog is gitignored generated output, so Gate 1's prefix check never sees a rewrite and it never lands in `wiki: promote`. Promotion stays additive-only, one wrapper commit, conflicts filed not resolved. Parser widen is read-only. If Music's 37-heading first run skip-floods, retire only headings named in existing commit-body verdicts (CONCEPT.md:45–48) and slice oldest N; fail closed if a promote commit lacks a Classification header. Do not adopt Brain deletion.

6) SEQUENCE. First, catalog writer + first-move flip + lint-timer emit across the listed vaults (add dng). Measure: `_meta/dirs.md` ≤600 tokens in every vault, and `rg -i wallpaper` on Scripts catalog returns the two pages qmd found in <0.1s. Second, date-parser + promotion timers on remaining vaults. Measure: 0 invalid ranges. Third, slice retirement only if the Music 37-heading run skip-floods.

challengeClaims: Nightly no-ops prove the cadence is wrong. Counter: install the existing promotion unit on Music and codebase-design with no cadence change; the next computed run must emit PROMOTION_REQUIRED=1. If it no-ops, cadence is the bug. If it classifies, coverage was the bug.

Orphan count is the right 'everything linked' metric. Counter: after catalog.jsonl lists every eligible page, an agent using only dirs.md + rg can name a previously orphan page with no inbound prose link. If that fails for >20% of today's orphans, inbound links matter.

A generated catalog will go stale the same way index.md did. Show a live miss where hash matches and a content page is absent.
